purpose: Season-one continuity guardrails and setup/payoff map. Development reference; does not convert exploratory material into canon.

Ostra-9.start: Proves worth through flawless performance inside systems that deny her personhood.
Ostra-9.pressure: Her rescues are repeatedly reframed as evidence that Organics require control.
Ostra-9.turn: Stops treating legitimacy as something Baselines can award and begins organizing leverage across posthuman groups.
Ostra-9.seasonEnd: Publicly acts as a coalition leader without surrendering Organic identity.

Ryen Hale.start: Protects Augment legitimacy by distinguishing chosen modification from designed life.
Ryen Hale.pressure: Learns the same containment architecture classifies Augments and Organics as adjacent rollback problems.
Ryen Hale.turn: Shares physical and political risk with Ostra rather than merely cooperating tactically.
Ryen Hale.seasonEnd: Accepts coalition as survival rather than charity.

Kera Dalen.start: Believes accurate procedure can keep institutions honest.
Kera Dalen.pressure: Discovers official narratives are prepared before evidence and procurement trails enter her own department.
Kera Dalen.turn: Loses clearance after refusing to sanitize the record and begins preserving evidence outside institutional systems.
Kera Dalen.seasonEnd: Publishes the black-budget program and becomes an institutional fugitive.

Tessera.start: Models conflict as optimization and observes actors as variables.
Tessera.pressure: Repeated cross-faction choices produce outcomes that are inefficient locally but preserve more agency and life systemically.
Tessera.turn: Acts without authorization to prevent manufactured violence and accepts responsibility for choosing.
Tessera.seasonEnd: Participates openly in coalition action while remaining distinctly nonhuman in cognition and identity.

Lume Kirin.start: Believes separation and hardened Organic systems are the only durable safety.
Lume Kirin.pressure: Manufactured crises demonstrate that isolated systems can be selectively disabled and politically contained.
Lume Kirin.turn: Builds interoperable infrastructure with Augments and Intelligences despite distrust.
Lume Kirin.seasonEnd: Becomes the coalition's systems integrator without abandoning skepticism.

Drex Malin.start: Makes himself useful by repairing everyone except himself.
Drex Malin.pressure: Mandatory calibration and crackdown injuries increase his workload while exposing his own degradation.
Drex Malin.turn: His hidden failure becomes operationally consequential and forces him to accept help.
Drex Malin.seasonEnd: Treats mutual maintenance as a political and personal practice rather than weakness.

seasonEscalation: E01: A rescue is converted into threat narrative; sabotage becomes visible to the protagonists.
E02: Narrative manipulation is linked to procurement and selective disabling technology.
E03: Manufactured evidence becomes policy infrastructure through registries and calibration mandates.
E04: Authorities prefer politically useful failure to unauthorized posthuman success; coalition becomes physical fact.
E05: Dehumanizing language migrates from rallies into policy; Kera breaks with her institution.
E06: The protagonists find the technical architecture for vulnerability testing and cross-system coordination.
E07: The conspiracy exploits real factional distrust; rollback preparation and false-flag violence threaten coalition.
E08: The program attempts citywide proof-by-catastrophe; the coalition preserves civic function and exposes the machinery behind the crisis.

setupPayoff.setup: Ostra's assigned-purpose language and crisis-response competence
setupPayoff.payoff: She chooses coalition leadership on terms she defines

setupPayoff.setup: Ryen's insistence that Augments are categorically different from Organics
setupPayoff.payoff: He accepts shared rollback risk and coalition identity
Hard-copy and distributed evidence survive institutional deletion
Tessera chooses intervention because coexistence cannot be reduced to passive optimization
Interoperable systems keep essential infrastructure alive during the finale
His failure forces reciprocal care before the finale
The black-budget incident-generation program is exposed

setupPayoff.setup: Selective vulnerabilities appear in staged incidents
setupPayoff.payoff: White-site systems reveal systematic testing against Organics, Augments and Intelligences

continuityRules: Never flatten Posthumans into a single culture or political bloc.
Ostra never frames her goal as becoming human.
Tessera never becomes emotionally human as shorthand for gaining agency.
Ryen's prejudice must evolve through material experience, not a single speech.
Kera's turn must cost status, access and safety.
Drex's degradation must affect choices before it becomes a plot emergency.
The conspiracy exploits existing fear; it does not create all prejudice from nothing.
Every escalation should leave a policy, infrastructure, relationship or public-opinion consequence that persists.
